title: Marine Lease Finance
summary: Search snippets (not the full page) show that Silver Oak Capital's Marine Lease Finance page presents yacht leasing as a common financing route in continental Europe (France, Italy, Malta), mainly for vessels bought in the Mediterranean. The firm arranges marine lease structures and works with major French and Italian leasing banks, positioning the lease as an alternative to a traditional marine mortgage. Under a lease the bank buys the boat (rather than holding a charge over a boat the client owns); at the end of the term the lessee has an 'Option to Purchase' the vessel outright for a nominal fee, often about 1% of value. The page says leasing has historically offered significant VAT advantages and flexibility for owners navigating EU waters. Pricing, eligibility criteria, lease durations, LTV for leases and process steps are NOT revealed by the results for this page; related figures (1.00% broker fee, up to 70% LTV, 5-7 year mortgages with ~25% balloon, >20m vessels) come from OTHER Silver Oak pages surfaced alongside. Query (c) returned nothing about Silver Oak at all.
